title: Smart Grid Power Line Installation
description: A utility company needs to connect a set of power stations spread across a region. You are given a 2D array points representing the coordinates of these stations, where points[i] = [x_i, y_i]. The cost of connecting two power stations is the Manhattan distance between them: |x_i - x_j| + |y_i - y_j|. Find the minimum total cost to make all power stations connected, either directly or indirectly through other stations.
input_format: A 2D array points containing integer coordinates.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum cost to connect all points.

examples.explanation: We can connect the points with a minimum total Manhattan distance of 20.
Connecting the stations optimally yields a total cost of 18.
Minimum spanning tree connects (0,0) to (1,0) [cost 1] and (1,0) to (1,1) [cost 1], totaling 2.
